scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @reservation-system/api" "npm run dev -w @reservation-system/web"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @reservation-system/api && npm run typecheck -w @reservation-system/web
